nodes.label: Package-only runtime boundary
nodes.rationale: Normal parser commands use packaged catalogs and must not silently read installed game templates or Assembly-CSharp.dll.

nodes.label: Fail-closed behavior
nodes.rationale: Unsupported mechanics, missing blocking dependencies, ambiguous player identity, and unresolved required references remain explicit rather than becoming guessed values.

nodes.label: Authoritative-prefix projection model
nodes.rationale: Completed verified projection transactions remain authoritative; an unsupported next action stops the affected path before its mutation executes.

nodes.label: Execution-derived metric coverage
nodes.rationale: Coverage follows the executed path and does not declare downstream metrics exact merely because a rule exists.

nodes.label: Catalog redistribution gate
nodes.rationale: The right to redistribute game-derived catalog contents is unverified; redistribution conditions must be established before transferring an archive outside the workspace.

nodes.label: MIT license scope
nodes.rationale: The project's MIT license does not apply to the contents of data/.

nodes.label: Model routing by task and uncertainty
nodes.rationale: GPT-6.1 Sol low coordinates; GPT-6 Luna low handles search/extraction; GPT-6 Luna xhigh handles routine implementation; GPT-6.1 Sol medium/high is used for broader integration or unresolved architecture/semantics.
nodes.norm_label: model routing by task and uncertainty

nodes.label: analyze bootstrap context
nodes.rationale: The analyze output helps an LLM select subsequent analysis without producing a comprehensive campaign dashboard.

nodes.label: Untrusted save strings
nodes.rationale: Save and report text must be treated as data rather than instructions; observed facts, calculations, assumptions, and missing dependencies remain distinct.

nodes.label: Executed-path coverage
nodes.rationale: Coverage follows the rule path and dependencies actually executed; a rule's existence alone does not establish metric coverage.

nodes.label: Authoritative prefix
nodes.rationale: Verified transactions and completions remain authoritative; an unsupported next action stops before mutation and excludes the affected plan from comparison.

nodes.label: Mean-path stochastic treatment
nodes.rationale: Deterministic mean-input trajectories are marked expected and do not claim to equal the expectation of nonlinear stochastic trajectories.

nodes.label: Package-only mechanics
nodes.rationale: Normal execution preserves packaged mechanics and existing result fields without projection refactoring or catalog regeneration.

nodes.label: Explicit compatibility consent
nodes.rationale: An unverified invocation requires explicit consent and cannot bypass catalog or mechanics dependencies.

nodes.label: AnalysisSession machine boundary
nodes.description: ti_parser_session.AnalysisSession represents one immutable save/runtime snapshot, is single-threaded, and reuses the save index, lazy snapshot and validated catalog bundles. run() is the versioned machine boundary; inspect(), analyze() and calculate() retain existing payload/exception contracts. calculation_scope() yields the indexed save for existing domain functions.

nodes.label: Canonical public argument schema
nodes.description: ti_parser_registry.get_input_schema() returns the canonical public argument schema for each callable analysis. Entity selectors accept names or integer IDs. Projection accepts parsed plan_payload JSON and integer-day checkpoints; CLI output/cache/template options are excluded from the Python boundary.

nodes.label: Schema-1 machine envelope
nodes.description: run() includes analysis, parserVersion, saveIdentity, compatibility and status, with result, missingDependencies or error as applicable. Statuses are complete, deferred, incomplete and error. Partial results retain full projection prefix, scope status and diagnostics. Unexpected programming exceptions and pre-construction save loading failures remain exceptions.

nodes.label: sha256-canonical-save-json-v1
nodes.description: saveIdentity schema 1 hashes parsed save JSON serialized with sorted keys, UTF-8 and compact separators. Python JSON NaN/Infinity tokens are preserved; this is not RFC canonical JSON. Path and mtime are excluded. Equivalent differently compressed JSON shares identity; changed saved content changes the fingerprint.

nodes.label: Capabilities registry inventory
nodes.description: capabilities lists application argument names/defaults and routingClass. Primary routes support run() and calculate(); inspect-save and analyze support run(). ti_parser_capabilities publishes the registry inventory.

nodes.label: Bounded LLM bootstrap analysis
nodes.description: analyze returns save/campaign/player identity, compatibility, core resource/research/CP context and availableAnalyses. Specialized commands are used on demand. Deferred or incomplete calculation reports remain usable JSON and exit with code 2.

nodes.label: Package-only runtime boundary
nodes.rationale: Normal CLI and Python API need Python only and use packaged runtime catalogs. Raw game templates and Assembly-CSharp.dll are generation, audit or catalog-verify inputs. --templates-dir is rejected for normal commands. Optional MCP SDK installation is isolated from normal parser operation.
nodes.community_name: Separate graph refresh preserves source commit provenance

nodes.label: Compatibility consent and fail-closed dependencies
nodes.rationale: Calculation commands require verified compatibility or per-invocation allow-unverified. The initial registry has no verified tuples. Consent never bypasses missing dependencies, unsupported scenarios or catalog integrity. Raw/type inspection and capabilities do not require consent.

nodes.label: Packaged runtime catalogs and manifest
nodes.description: data catalogs cover effects, traits, orgs, research, ships, nation claims, hab modules and locations. catalog_manifest.json records file SHA-256, schema version, payload fingerprints and bundle fingerprint. Catalog envelopes contain deterministic source hashes and exact scenario overrides; timestamps and mtimes are excluded. Unsupported scenarios never inherit other scenario values.
nodes.community_name: Separate graph refresh preserves source commit provenance

nodes.label: Catalog verification and fresh-export release gate
nodes.description: catalog-verify rebuilds normalized reference catalogs from raw templates and compares matching-save calculations with rel_tol=1e-9 and abs_tol=1e-6. Failed or unavailable checks exit 2. verify_fresh_export.py archives HEAD with core.autocrlf=false, runs full/package-only suites and loads supported scenarios to validate committed bytes and manifest hashes.
nodes.community_name: Separate graph refresh preserves source commit provenance
nodes.norm_label: catalog verification and fresh-export release gate

nodes.label: Authoritative-prefix projection and execution-derived coverage
nodes.rationale: nation-projection clones state without mutating the save. Completed verified transactions remain in the authoritative prefix; unsupported next mutations are never executed. metricCoverage follows executed inputs and outputs. Independent missing world-market values can mark only worldMarket incomplete while nation/faction scopes remain complete. runtimeStop preserves exact stop context and evidence.

nodes.label: Mean-input and expected-transition treatments
nodes.description: Population uses deterministicMeanInput; Unity uses deterministicExpectedTransition and requires stochasticPolicy.unityPublicOpinion meanPath consent. Both report expected coverage, meanPath provenance and expectationGuarantee false. Neither claims mathematical expectation over the complete nonlinear stochastic trajectory.

nodes.label: Evidence-backed planning views
nodes.rationale: research-plan preserves separate strategic signals for human/LLM judgment. hab-plan is a heuristic shortlist with slot opportunity costs rather than a full optimizer. project-analysis ranks transparent axes and bounded unlocked-module samples. ship-plan uses transparent drive/weapon proxies and saved-design non-combat simulation rather than combat performance ratings.

nodes.label: Optional stdio MCP adapter and SDK-independent schemas
nodes.description: ti_parser_mcp is an optional stdio adapter whose SDK dependency is isolated in requirements-mcp.txt. ti_parser_schema describes application machine envelopes and save-free capabilities without importing MCP SDK. Runtime ZIP includes adapter source and requirements, while SDK installation is optional and separate.
nodes.norm_label: optional stdio mcp adapter and sdk-independent schemas

nodes.label: Optional local stdio MCP adapter scope
nodes.description: Issue #6 delivers local stdio MCP tools over the existing machine application API, without remote transport, game mechanics changes or catalog regeneration. Typed tools derive from canonical registry input schemas and declare application-owned output schemas.
nodes.norm_label: optional local stdio mcp adapter scope

nodes.label: Phased plan source of truth
nodes.rationale: 00-master-plan.md is the implementation plan source of truth; phase files define local scope and validation. Earlier monolithic plans are input material only unless explicitly retained. Phases 4 and 5 extend the delivered adapter after the 2026-10-01 scope update; phase 6 verifies both.

nodes.label: Two-session reuse and compressed-byte invalidation
nodes.description: At most two sessions are reused; compressed-save SHA-256 is checked every call and session use is serialized. Application save identity remains authoritative; cache hashes are compressed-byte invalidation keys only. Runtime-data replacement requires server restart.

nodes.label: Schema completion verification record
nodes.description: Input contracts/choices: a3b346d; output schemas/protocol checks: 39bf4c9; packaging/docs: 6107c32. SDK-free checkout and fresh export each: 444 passed, 16 skipped, 75 subtests. Package-only/raw-loader checks: 6 passed. SDK-enabled MCP: 17 passed. Standalone ZIP: 61 files. Pre-existing Windows CI failure remains separate; no push or publication.
nodes.community_name: Separate graph refresh preserves source commit provenance

nodes.label: Registry owns canonical caller-visible input schemas
nodes.rationale: The registry is the sole caller-visible analysis input-schema owner. Reuse public parameter discovery and existing choices; preserve unions/defaults and exclude private overrides. MCP replaces introspection with canonical schemas and adds only transport fields. Schema descriptions do not replace domain validation or normalization.
nodes.norm_label: registry owns canonical caller-visible input schemas

nodes.label: Fresh schema shapes and shared choice metadata
nodes.description: Fresh get_input_schema() results cannot mutate later results. Handler support includes Literal, tuples, Mapping and Path. Existing choices/research modes are centralized; research mode enum is all/global/project. Projection-root validation is shared with the adapter to preserve pre-session errors.
nodes.norm_label: fresh schema shapes and shared choice metadata

nodes.label: Input-schema phase validation
nodes.description: tests/test_input_schema.py and tests/test_application_api.py yielded 44 SDK-free passes. SDK client smoke exposed 22 tools; save-free inventory contains 21 analysis routes. Adapter tests and projection/planning/forecast schema inspection are validation targets.

nodes.label: SDK-independent application-owned output schemas
nodes.description: Fresh schemas cover analysis envelopes, identity, compatibility, pre-session errors and capabilities. MCP registers common analysis and separate capabilities outputSchema declarations. Full envelopes are distinguished from small errors; existing fallback compatibility fields are preserved.

nodes.label: Output contracts preserve existing payloads and evidence
nodes.rationale: Output schemas permit arbitrary domain JSON and existing evidence extensions, without reshaping results, typing every domain result or adding runtime dependencies. Pre-session errors never fabricate saveIdentity. Error results are explicitly validated and structured content equals JSON text.
nodes.norm_label: output contracts preserve existing payloads and evidence

nodes.label: Output-schema protocol verification
nodes.description: SDK-free structural checks: 3 passed. SDK protocol tests: 14 passed, including tool-error validation, unresolved-player/compatibility-registry paths, missing dependencies and unchanged partial projection evidence. Smoke confirmed 22 output schemas, save-free capabilities and structured missing-save errors. ZIP checks follow commit because archive uses HEAD.

nodes.label: Schema regression and distribution verification phase
nodes.norm_label: schema regression and distribution verification phase

nodes.label: SDK-free and SDK-enabled distribution verification
nodes.description: Real contract-shaped fixtures validate output failures, extracted ZIP stdio and SDK-free CLI. Checkout/fresh-export suites each: 444 passed, 16 skipped, 75 subtests. Adapter/ZIP stdio: 17 passed. Distribution membership/tamper: 14 passed. Fresh-export guards: 6 passed; six supported scenarios load. Archive passes stdlib-only -I -S isolation outside checkout with network/game-input guards.

nodes.label: Separate graph refresh preserves source commit provenance
nodes.rationale: Graph refresh follows final source records and generated output is committed separately so the graph can stamp the source commit without circular identity. Archive requirements must track schema helper availability; regenerated graph must match committed sources.
nodes.community_name: Separate graph refresh preserves source commit provenance
nodes.norm_label: separate graph refresh preserves source commit provenance

nodes.label: Existing Windows CI failure remains outside scope
nodes.rationale: Only new regressions are investigated in this change. Pre-change 2091cc3 had eight MCP jobs and four Linux jobs green, with four ordinary Windows pytest failures. Local Python 3.14.3 tests without MCP pass but do not establish the cause of the separate CI failure. No push or external publication is requested.
nodes.norm_label: existing windows ci failure remains outside scope

nodes.label: Local stdin/stdout MCP transport
nodes.description: Optional MCP exposes the same application analysis session as the Python API, reads local .gz saves and never starts a network listener. Protocol messages use stdout, diagnostics use stderr and save contents are data. Hosts launch the adapter by absolute path; working directory does not locate the repository.

nodes.label: Optional MCP SDK installation boundary
nodes.rationale: CLI/Python API remain package-only without third-party packages. ZIP includes adapter source and pinned requirements but not SDK. Install requirements-mcp.txt only in the launch environment. Missing SDK causes an installation message on stderr and does not affect CLI use.

nodes.label: Registry-derived MCP tool input contract
nodes.description: Tools expose inspect-save, analyze and primary registry routes plus save-free no-argument capabilities. Analysis tools require non-empty save_path; all other names/defaults follow get_input_schema(). MCP adds only save_path and eligible allow_unverified=false consent, rejects unknown properties, and preserves constrained choices, nullable selectors and typed arrays. nation-projection plan_payload is object/null and checkpoints is integer array/null.

nodes.label: Declared MCP output schemas and errors
nodes.description: Application ti_parser_schema helpers declare outputSchema for session envelopes, smaller pre-session errors and separate capabilities inventory. In-session schema 1 includes analysis, parserVersion, saveIdentity, compatibility and status. Pre-session errors lack identity/compatibility evidence. Structured content and JSON text are equivalent; error status is MCP tool error while deferred/incomplete are analysis outcomes. Domain evidence and authoritative prefix are retained.
nodes.norm_label: declared mcp output schemas and errors

nodes.label: Bounded session cache and save-byte validation
nodes.description: Adapter retains at most two sessions per process keyed by normalized absolute save path and checks save byte hash on every call. Changed saves replace cached sessions. Replacing parser files or packaged runtime catalogs requires adapter restart.
nodes.norm_label: bounded session cache and save-byte validation
